args.message: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money to match FIN-212 and existing tests

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding-FIN-212
args.title: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented it with ROUND_HALF_UP, even though its docstring already claimed ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

## Changes

- `src/money.py`: switched `amount.quantize(...)` rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented behavior in FIN-212.

## Verification

- CI run on this branch passed (all tests green, including `test_half_even`).
